tasks.title: Demo Debate: Should School Start Later?
tasks.prompt: Engage in a live debate on whether school should start later in the morning. Use the starting points below to prepare your arguments. Listen carefully to your opponents and respond respectfully. Focus on clear evidence and strong reasoning to support your position.
tasks.resolution: School should start later in the morning for middle and high school students.
proPoints: Starting school later helps students get more sleep, improving their health and focus.
Later start times can lead to better academic performance and reduced tardiness.
Teenagers’ natural sleep cycles make early mornings challenging, so a later start matches their biology.
conPoints: Starting later could interfere with after-school activities and sports schedules.
Later start times may cause conflicts for parents’ work schedules and transportation.
Changing start times could reduce the amount of daylight after school, affecting safety and activities.
judgingCriteria: Evidence: Use facts, studies, and examples to support your arguments.
Clarity: Speak clearly and organize your points logically.
Respect: Listen to others and respond politely without interrupting.
Rebuttal: Address opposing points directly with thoughtful counterarguments.

tasks.title: Role-Play Scenarios: Practice Communication
tasks.prompt: Choose a scenario and role to act out. Work with your classmates to achieve your role's goal while following your role's constraint.

config.scenario: You are participating in various everyday situations where communication and problem-solving are key. Each scenario involves three roles with different goals and constraints. Collaborate and negotiate to reach your objectives.

roles.name: Customer
roles.goal: Explain your problem clearly and get a helpful solution.
roles.constraint: You can only speak for 2 minutes and must remain polite.

roles.name: Store Assistant
roles.goal: Understand the customer's issue and offer the best possible help.
roles.constraint: You cannot use technical jargon and must ask clarifying questions.

roles.name: Manager
roles.goal: Ensure the customer leaves satisfied while following store policies.
roles.constraint: You can only intervene if the conversation is stuck or escalating.

roles.name: Team Member A
roles.goal: Convince your team to choose your idea for the project.
roles.constraint: You cannot interrupt others and must listen carefully.

roles.name: Team Member B
roles.goal: Support your idea with facts and examples to persuade the team.
roles.constraint: You can only speak twice during the discussion.

roles.name: Team Leader
roles.goal: Help the team reach a decision everyone agrees on.
roles.constraint: You must remain neutral and summarize points without giving your opinion.

roles.name: Friend A
roles.goal: Plan a fun weekend activity that everyone will enjoy.
roles.constraint: You must consider everyone's preferences and avoid conflicts.

roles.name: Friend B
roles.goal: Suggest a budget-friendly activity for the group.
roles.constraint: You cannot mention any activities that cost more than $10.

roles.name: Friend C
roles.goal: Encourage the group to try something new and exciting.
roles.constraint: You must be positive but respectful of others' opinions.

roles.name: Teacher
roles.goal: Guide the students to work together and complete the task.
roles.constraint: You can only give hints, not direct answers.

roles.name: Student A
roles.goal: Share your ideas clearly to contribute to the group work.
roles.constraint: You must wait for your turn to speak.

roles.name: Student B
roles.goal: Listen carefully and build on others' ideas.
roles.constraint: You cannot repeat what others have already said.

lines: Alex: Hey team, we have a big project due next week. How should we start?

Taylor: Good idea! I’m great at research, so I can handle that part.
Morgan: I like designing presentations. I’ll make sure our slides look great.
Alex: Perfect! And I can organize our meetings and keep track of deadlines.
Jamie: Working together like this will make the project easier and better.
Taylor: Plus, we learn from each other and support one another.
Morgan: Teamwork really helps us achieve more than working alone.
